verdict.rationale: dlt's docs explicitly describe automatic schema inference plus 'schema and data contracts' that let dlt 'handle these schema changes, enabling you to adapt to changes without losing velocity' (dlt-docs-4, dlt-docs-20/36/54/65), and merge/incremental strategies (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-27, dlt-docs-49) show configurable load behaviors rather than silent breakage. However the evidence pack never details the actual contract policy options (e.g., freeze/evolve/discard modes) a data engineer would choose, and a community comment flags the automatic schema handling as an 'opaque' default some users dislike (dlt-comm-4), signaling real configurability/visibility gaps rather than a full user-selectable policy story. missing for 10: concrete documentation of selectable schema-contract policy modes (freeze/discard/evolve), independent confirmation the contract system prevents breakage in practice.
